blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
A sincere "thank you" is worth more than a thousand emails. Drivers do the hardest part of logistics. They work long hours on long roads, in rain, wind and difficult weather.

Today we practise polite words. These words turn a boss into a colleague, and a colleague into a friend. It is simple: "thank you", "please", "sorry", and "you're welcome".

Say thank you in a specific way. "Thanks for covering the storm shift" is better than just "thanks". Public thanks costs nothing, but it keeps the team together on hard days.

items.q: According to the text, what do drivers do?
options: The easiest part of the job
items.why: "Drivers do the hardest part of logistics."

items.q: What is worth more than a thousand emails?
items.why: "A sincere 'thank you' is worth more than a thousand emails."

items.q: The text says polite words can turn a boss into a…
items.why: "These words turn a boss into a colleague."

items.q: The author would most likely DISAGREE with…
options: "Saying thank you is a waste of time."
"Say thank you in a specific way."
items.why: Inferência: o texto todo defende agradecer, então o autor discordaria de que é perda de tempo.

items.q: "Public thanks costs nothing" suggests that…
options: you must pay to say thank you
thanking people is free and easy
only money keeps a team together
items.why: Inferência: "costs nothing" quer dizer que é grátis e simples agradecer.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Emily falando com o time de motoristas. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Good morning, everyone. Thank you so much for coming in early today. I have some very good news to share.

This week we had zero delays. Zero! Every single truck arrived on time. That is excellent work, and it is because of you — all of you.

I want to say thank you to each driver. Carlos, thank you for covering the storm shift on Tuesday. The rain was very heavy, the road was dark, but you stayed calm and safe. Maria, thank you for helping the new driver on his first day. You showed him the route, and that was very kind.

I know the roads are long and the hours are hard. Sometimes you start before the sun and you finish after dark. Please know that we see it, and we are grateful. A team like this is not normal — it is special.

So, from all of us: thank you. Now, please have some coffee and a good breakfast before you go. And one more thing — drive safely today. Your family wants you home. Keep it up, and see you all tomorrow.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What good news does Emily share?
items.why: "This week we had zero delays. Zero!"

items.q: Why does Emily thank Carlos?
options: For covering the storm shift on Tuesday
items.why: "Carlos, thank you for covering the storm shift on Tuesday."

items.q: What does Emily ask the drivers to do before they go?
items.why: "Please have some coffee and a good breakfast before you go."

items.q: When Emily says "drive safely today, your family wants you home", she shows that she…
options: cares about the drivers as people
items.why: Inferência: pedir para dirigir com segurança e lembrar da família mostra cuidado com as pessoas.

items.q: How does Emily feel about the team?
items.why: Inferência: ela elogia ("excellent work", "special") e agradece muito — está orgulhosa e grata.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Thank you for your help today." Thank you is a way to…
items.why: Thank you = obrigado(a): você mostra gratidão.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "___ send me the report before lunch."
items.why: Please = por favor: torna o pedido educado.

items.q: "I am sorry for the late reply." Sorry means…
options: you say excuse me or apologise
items.why: Sorry = desculpe: você se desculpa.

items.q: Someone says "thank you", and you answer: "You're ___."
items.why: "You're welcome" = de nada: a resposta educada a um agradecimento.

items.q: "Zero delays this week — that is excellent!" Excellent means…
items.why: Excellent = excelente, muito bom.

blocks.instruction: Expressões educadas do dia a dia no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "I really appreciate it." This means…
items.why: Appreciate it = agradecer de forma mais forte que "thanks".

items.q: "Could you help me with this box?" "Could you" is a way to…
items.why: "Could you…" = forma educada e profissional de pedir.

items.q: At the end of the day, a caring boss says: "Drive safely." This means…
items.why: "Drive safely" = dirija com cuidado; é uma despedida atenciosa.

items.q: "Thanks for covering the storm shift." To cover a shift means to…
items.why: Cover a shift = cobrir o turno, trabalhar no lugar de alguém.

items.q: "Great job, everyone — keep it up!" This means…
items.why: Keep it up = continue assim, mantenha o bom trabalho.
